factory_line.description: Lying across the box: the Conveyor Belt with two of Rook's spare tool arms bolted above it and the Toolbox at the end.

master_blueprint.brief: Rolled blueprint of a satellite shell with a pencil tucked in. Accent: teal.
master_blueprint.description: A rolled blueprint half open, showing the outline of a satellite shell like Rook's, a pencil tucked into the roll. Teal paper.

perpetual_engine.brief: Small engine with a flywheel, patched from three different wrecks. Accent: copper.
perpetual_engine.description: Lying across the box: a small engine with a big flywheel, patched together from three different wrecks, each part a different metal.

nanite_swarm.brief: Cloud of tiny robots, each a minute copy of Rook, forming a cube. Accent: teal.
nanite_swarm.description: Lying across the box: a cloud of tiny robots, each a minute copy of Rook with a satellite shell, forming a rough cube.

capacitor_bank.brief: Row of three fat salvaged capacitors on a scrap board. Accent: mustard.
capacitor_bank.description: Lying across the box: three fat salvaged capacitors in a row on a scrap board, mustard bands round each.

bolt_thrower.brief: Small crossbow built from a tool leg, firing bolts. Accent: copper.
bolt_thrower.description: Upright: a small crossbow built from one of Rook's tool legs, a bolt loaded, the string made of copper wire.

grav_clamp.brief: Heavy clamp with a gravity ring symbol, taken from a docking arm. Accent: teal.
grav_clamp.description: A heavy clamp taken from a docking arm, a teal gravity ring symbol on its jaw.

shield_emitter.brief: Small dish emitter cut from a satellite antenna. Accent: teal.
shield_emitter.description: A small dish emitter cut from a satellite antenna like the ones on Rook's shell, a teal ring of force in front.

turbo_fan.brief: Cooling fan from a wreck with bent blades. Accent: copper.
turbo_fan.description: A cooling fan from a wreck with bent copper blades in a square frame.

scrap_golem.brief: Walking robot of scrap with a single mustard lantern eye. Accent: copper.
scrap_golem.description: Lying across the box: a walking robot of scrap, a single mustard lantern eye like Rook's, mismatched legs.

rail_driver.brief: Long rail gun made from two salvaged copper rails. Accent: copper.
rail_driver.description: Along the long box: a long rail gun made from two salvaged copper rails, bound together with wire and clamps.

bastion_frame.brief: Heavy armour frame of hull plates, like a bigger shell. Accent: copper.
bastion_frame.description: Filling the square box: a heavy armour frame of hull plates shaped like a bigger satellite shell for Rook, a hatch in the middle.

quantum_forge.brief: Anvil inside an atom-shaped cage of bent rails. Accent: mustard.
quantum_forge.description: Filling the square box: an anvil inside an atom-shaped cage of bent rails, mustard sparks where the rails cross.

rivet_cannon.brief: Big rivet gun on a three-legged stand. Accent: copper.
rivet_cannon.description: Upright through the tall box: a big rivet gun on a three-legged stand, the legs taken from the Bolt Thrower and the Welding Arm.

dynamo.brief: Generator with a spinning drum and loose wires. Accent: mustard.
dynamo.description: Lying across the box: a generator with a spinning drum, the Turbo Fan on one side, loose wires to the Capacitor Bank.

bulwark_array.brief: Row of dish emitters on a scrap frame. Accent: teal.
bulwark_array.description: Filling the square box: a row of dish emitters on the Bastion Frame, each a Shield Emitter, teal rings of force overlapping.

storm_driver.brief: Rail gun with ink storm lines and zig-zag sparks around the barrel. Accent: mustard.
storm_driver.description: The rail gun runs along the top row, a battery box hangs in the lower left; the lower right cells stay empty. The Rail Driver with the Dynamo strapped under it, flat mustard sparks around the barrel.

junk_titan.brief: Huge robot made of scrap with a satellite housing on its back. Accent: copper.
junk_titan.description: Filling the square box: a huge robot made of scrap, a curved satellite housing on its back like Rook's shell, Spare Parts sticking out of every joint.

gravity_well.brief: Ring machine pulling small bolts into its middle. Accent: teal.
gravity_well.description: Lying across the box: a ring machine on the Magnet Crane's arm, small bolts being pulled into its middle, teal rings.

sun_shard.brief: Broken piece of a dying sun, cracked flat mustard and rust, wavy heat lines. Accent: mustard.
sun_shard.description: A broken piece of a dying sun, cracked flat mustard and rust, wavy heat lines rising, no glow.

prayer_bell.brief: Small iron bell on a wrist cord, like the one Ysel wears. Accent: mustard.
prayer_bell.description: A small iron bell on a wrist cord, the same as the one Ysel wears, a mustard clapper.

eclipse_veil.brief: Heavy dark veil cloth with a coral red band and a black disc stitched on. Accent: cream.
eclipse_veil.description: Lying across the box: a heavy dark veil cloth of Ysel's order with a coral red band, a black disc stitched on, folded once.

sundial.brief: Iron sundial whose shadow points at a cracked star. Accent: copper.
sundial.description: A small iron sundial whose shadow points at a cracked star cut into the plate.

flare_catcher.brief: Bent iron ring on a pole catching a curling flare. Accent: mustard.
flare_catcher.description: Lying across the box: a bent iron ring on a pole catching a curling flare, the flare drawn as a flat mustard ribbon.

ember_censer.brief: Hanging iron censer with embers and wavy heat lines. Accent: coral red.
ember_censer.description: Upright: a hanging iron censer on chains with embers inside, wavy heat lines rising from its lid.

corona_staff.brief: Staff topped by an open iron cage holding a cracked sun fragment. Accent: mustard.
corona_staff.description: Upright staff of Ysel's order: a plain dark iron shaft with a coral red band, crowned by an open cage of bent iron rings like her own reliquary. Inside floats a cracked sun piece, flat mustard with black cracks and wavy heat lines.

comet_rosary.brief: Rosary of small stones with one comet-shaped bead. Accent: cream.
comet_rosary.description: Along the long box: a rosary of small round stones like the ones on Ysel's belt, one bead shaped like a comet.

dawn_chime.brief: Iron chime of hanging tubes cut with sun rays. Accent: mustard.
dawn_chime.description: An iron chime of hanging tubes, each tube cut with small sun rays.

red_giant_heart.brief: Swollen red star in a cage of bent iron rings, cracks widening. Accent: coral red.
red_giant_heart.description: Filling the square box: a swollen coral red star in a cage of bent iron rings like a reliquary, its cracks widening, heat drawn as wavy lines.

collapse_engine.brief: Iron machine with a cracked star collapsing into its core. Accent: coral red.
collapse_engine.description: Lying across the box: an iron machine with a cracked star collapsing into its core, pieces falling inward.

sunblade.brief: Short iron sword with a sun shard set in the hilt. Accent: mustard.
sunblade.description: Upright: a short iron sword of the order, the Sun Shard set in the hilt, the Crystal Shard ground into its edge.

chime_of_hours.brief: Iron bell with a sundial on top. Accent: mustard.
chime_of_hours.description: Lying across the box: the Prayer Bell with the Sundial fixed on top as its crown.

helios_rod.brief: Long iron rod topped by a small burning sun in rings. Accent: mustard.
helios_rod.description: Upright through the tall box: the Corona Staff grown longer, the Ember Censer hanging from its top cage, a small burning sun inside.

umbral_mantle.brief: Heavy dark robe of the order with coral red bands, its shadow longer than it should be. Accent: cream.
umbral_mantle.description: Filling the square box: the heavy dark robe of Ysel's order with coral red bands, laid flat, its shadow longer than it should be.

dying_star_scepter.brief: Sceptre with a red dying star trapped in a cage of bent iron rings. Accent: coral red.
dying_star_scepter.description: The cage fills the upper four cells, the shaft drops into the lower left; the lower right stays empty. A sceptre with the Red Giant Heart trapped in a cage of bent iron rings.

solstice_engine.brief: Iron engine with two half-suns on its sides. Accent: mustard.
solstice_engine.description: Filling the square box: an iron engine with two half-suns on its sides, the Dawn Chime hanging from it, the Flare Catcher's ring on top.

nova_crown.brief: Crown of bent iron rings around a dark, frozen star. Accent: teal.
nova_crown.description: Lying across the box: a crown of bent iron rings around a dark star gone cold, frost cracks on its surface, pieces held still in the rings.

eternal_dawn.brief: Small sun rising out of an iron ring, never quite up. Accent: mustard.
eternal_dawn.description: A small sun rising out of an iron ring, never quite up, half hidden behind the ring.

stellar_lens.brief: Large lens in an iron frame focusing a star into a beam. Accent: teal.
stellar_lens.description: A large lens in an iron frame focusing a star into a single teal beam.

votive_candle.brief: Candle in a small stone cup, a star pressed into the wax. Accent: mustard.
votive_candle.description: A candle in a small stone cup, a star pressed into the wax, a flat mustard flame.

hymn_scroll.brief: Open prayer scroll covered in star-phase symbols. Accent: cream.
hymn_scroll.description: Lying across the box: an open prayer scroll of the solar moths, covered in small star-phase symbols instead of letters.

solar_dagger.brief: Iron dagger with a sun etched on the blade. Accent: mustard.
solar_dagger.description: A small iron dagger with a mustard sun etched on the blade.

mirror_of_dusk.brief: Iron hand mirror showing a setting red sun. Accent: coral red.
mirror_of_dusk.description: Upright: an iron hand mirror showing a setting coral red sun.

star_psalter.brief: Thick hymn book with an iron star clasp. Accent: mustard.
star_psalter.description: Lying across the box: a thick hymn book of the order with an iron star clasp.

pyre_lantern.brief: Iron lantern with a small fire inside, heat lines above. Accent: coral red.
pyre_lantern.description: An iron lantern with a small fire inside, wavy heat lines rising from the top.

eclipse_orb.brief: Stone orb with a black disc crossing a sun. Accent: cream.
eclipse_orb.description: Lying across the box: a stone orb with a black disc crossing a sun, held in a small iron stand.

white_dwarf.brief: Small, very dense white star held in a heavy iron ring. Accent: cream.
white_dwarf.description: Filling the square box: a small, very dense cream star held in a heavy iron ring, the ring bending under its weight.

supernova_seed.brief: Seed-shaped iron cage with a star about to burst inside. Accent: coral red.
supernova_seed.description: Lying across the box: a seed-shaped iron cage with a star about to burst inside, its cracks coral red.

twin_suns.brief: Two sun daggers crossed. Accent: mustard.
twin_suns.description: Upright: the Sun Shard and the Solar Dagger crossed, both with sun marks in mustard.

sacred_flame.brief: Flame in a stone bowl, wavy heat lines rising. Accent: coral red.
sacred_flame.description: A flame in a stone bowl like the Votive Candle's cup, the Pyre Lantern's iron frame around it, wavy heat lines.

litany.brief: Long scroll wrapped around an iron bell. Accent: cream.
litany.description: Along the long box: the Prayer Scroll wrapped around an iron bell, the Comet Rosary hanging from it.

total_eclipse.brief: Round iron shield painted with a total eclipse. Accent: cream.
total_eclipse.description: The shield fills the top row and the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. A round iron shield painted with a total eclipse, the Mirror of Dusk set in its centre.

event_horizon.brief: Black ring shield with stars bending around its edge. Accent: teal.
event_horizon.description: Filling the tall box: a black ring shield with stars bending round its edge, the White Dwarf at its centre, the Umbral Mantle hanging behind it.

canticle.brief: Open book of last light with a flare curling up from its pages. Accent: mustard.
canticle.description: Lying across the box: the Star Psalter open as a book of last light, a flare curling up from its pages as a flat mustard ribbon.

space_hamster.brief: Round hamster with ore-stuffed cheeks and breathing gills. Accent: mustard.
space_hamster.description: A round hamster from a thin-air desert planet, cheeks stuffed with shiny ore pebbles, frilly breathing gills on its neck, small room around it. Mustard fur.

moon_moth.brief: Pale moth with two crescent moons on each wing. Accent: cream.
moon_moth.description: A pale moth from a planet with two moons, each wing marked with two dark crescents, feathery antennae, fuzzy body, wings spread wide.

vacuum_slug.brief: Hull slug with a suction mouth and a helmet-like shell. Accent: sage.
vacuum_slug.description: Lying across the box: a fat slug that lives on ship hulls in open vacuum, a round suction mouth at the front, a little dome shell like a pressure helmet on its back, a sage slime trail behind it.

rock_crab.brief: Flat crab pressed low by gravity, eyes on long periscope stalks. Accent: copper.
rock_crab.description: A squat crab pressed flat by the heavy gravity of Ochre, its shell layered red sandstone, short thick legs, and two eyes on very long periscope stalks to look over the dunes. One thick crystal claw.

glow_beetle.brief: Beetle with a lamp rear and a ringed-planet shell. Accent: mustard.
glow_beetle.description: A beetle seen from above, its rear end a round lamp drawn as a flat mustard shape, its shell patterned like a tiny planet with one ring.

asteroid_mole.brief: Mole with diamond claws and a tiny tail jet for drifting. Accent: copper.
asteroid_mole.description: Upright: a stubby mole standing on its hind legs, huge diamond-tipped digging claws, an asteroid crumb on its nose, its tail ending in a tiny jet for drifting between rocks.

dust_bunny.brief: Fluffy tumbleweed bunny with a dust devil spinning under it. Accent: cream.
dust_bunny.description: A round ball of grey fluff from a windy desert planet, rolling like a tumbleweed, two long ears, two dot eyes, a tiny dust devil spinning under it.

scout_drone.brief: Round drone with one big camera eye and rotor arms. Accent: teal.
scout_drone.description: Upright: a small round drone with one big teal camera eye, two little rotor arms on top and a thin fold-out antenna tail below.

comet_fox.brief: Long-legged comet fox mid-leap with a dust-trail tail. Accent: cream.
comet_fox.description: A lean fox from a small icy comet, long thin legs for low gravity, mid-leap across the box. Its tail streams behind it as a long trail of frozen dust like a comet tail. Big ears like tiny antenna dishes.

repair_bot.brief: Small wrench-armed robot carrying a roll of hull tape. Accent: mustard.
repair_bot.description: Upright: a small round robot on two stubby legs, one arm a wrench, one round mustard eye, a roll of hull tape worn like a backpack.

laser_parrot.brief: Round parrot from Gemell with a lens beak and a dish crest. Accent: coral red.
laser_parrot.description: A plump parrot from Gemell's twilight forests standing upright, wings folded, its beak a coral red lens in a copper ring, its crest a small fanned dish, big dusk eyes.

nebula_jelly.brief: Jellyfish with a nebula cloud inside its bell. Accent: teal.
nebula_jelly.description: Lying across the box: a jellyfish drifting through the Veil nebula, its bell a see-through dome with a small teal swirl of nebula cloud inside, tentacles trailing behind like dust trails.

sentry_drone.brief: Hovering drone with a small gun underneath. Accent: coral red.
sentry_drone.description: Upright: a hovering drone with a small coral red gun mounted underneath, two rotor arms on top, one lens eye.

magma_newt.brief: Basalt-skinned newt with heat cracks and a glass tail. Accent: coral red.
magma_newt.description: A newt from a lava planet lying across the box, its skin cracked like cooling black basalt with coral red heat in the cracks as flat colour, its tail ending in a lump of volcanic glass, steam as wavy ink lines.

ice_ferret.brief: Slinky Rime ferret with an ice-crystal crest along its spine. Accent: teal.
ice_ferret.description: Lying across the box: a long slinky ferret from Rime, white fur, a crest of clear teal ice crystals along its spine, big pale eyes, its tail curled round a chunk of methane ice.

tardigrade.brief: Chubby tardigrade in a tiny space helmet, unbothered. Accent: cream.
tardigrade.description: A chubby wrinkled cream tardigrade with eight stubby clawed legs, wearing a tiny round space helmet it does not need, looking completely unbothered.

shadow_lynx.brief: Shadow cat with an eclipse ring round its outline. Accent: mustard.
shadow_lynx.description: The lynx's body fills the top row, its head and front paws drop into the lower left cell; the right lower cell stays empty. A cat of pure black shadow rimmed by a thin mustard ring like a solar eclipse, ear tufts, two cream eyes.

star_whale_calf.brief: Chubby baby whale with star freckles swimming through space. Accent: teal.
star_whale_calf.description: Filling the wide box: a chubby baby whale swimming sideways through space, its back speckled with small stars like freckles, a big curious eye and a short spout of mist. Underbelly in pale bone with grooves, the back teal.

void_kraken.brief: Dark tentacled beast with one huge teal eye. Accent: teal.
void_kraken.description: A dark tentacled beast filling the box: head and body across the top two rows, two thick tentacles hanging into the bottom corners, the middle bottom cell empty. One huge round eye in teal is the focus; suckers as plain cream dots, skin night-blue under heavy black shadow.

guardian_drone.brief: Drone holding a round shield plate in front of it. Accent: teal.
guardian_drone.description: Lying across the box: a drone hovering behind a round shield plate held in front of it by two arms, teal on the shield.

purifier_bot.brief: Small robot with a big filter mask for a face. Accent: sage.
purifier_bot.description: A small robot with a big sage air filter mask for a face, a little round body and two thin arms.

laser_pistol.brief: Chunky pistol whose barrel is a stack of lens rings, solar fin on the back. Accent: coral red.
laser_pistol.description: Upright, barrel pointing up: a chunky pistol whose barrel is a short stack of three teal lens rings, a small solar fin on its back to recharge it, the grip wrapped in tape.

rivet_gun.brief: Hull-repair gun from a thruster nozzle, rivets riding round it like a planet ring. Accent: copper.
rivet_gun.description: A stubby hull-repair gun built from a cut-down thruster nozzle. Fat rivets ride round the barrel on a wire ring like a planet ring; the muzzle is a rubber suction clamp for hull plates. Copper hose fittings.

plasma_cutter.brief: Wreck-salvage cutter with a short plasma blade and a magnet clamp. Accent: coral red.
plasma_cutter.description: Lying across the box: a wreck-salvage cutter built from a welding torch and a ship's fuel valve, a short flat coral red blade of plasma at the nozzle, a magnet clamp on the housing so it sticks to hulls in zero gravity.

asteroid_chunk.brief: A throwable little asteroid with a carry strap and a pebble moon beside it. Accent: copper.
asteroid_chunk.description: Lying across the box: a lumpy grey-brown little asteroid with a carry strap bolted on so it can be thrown, a tiny pebble moon floating close beside it.

stun_baton.brief: Baton from a broken antenna mast, spark between two prongs. Accent: mustard.
stun_baton.description: Upright, prongs at the top: a baton made from a broken antenna mast, two bent prongs with a flat mustard zig-zag spark between them, a short coiled tether cord with a clip at the grip end.

mining_pick.brief: L-shaped meteor-iron pick with a crystal tip and a small thruster. Accent: teal.
mining_pick.description: The pick head runs along the top two cells, the handle drops down the left cell; the empty corner stays free. Meteor-iron head with a teal crystal tip and a small thruster on its back, taped grip, tether clip.

fang_dagger.brief: A crystal-tipped fang lashed to a short hilt. Accent: cream.
fang_dagger.description: A single curved cream fang of a crystal-toothed beast from Facet, its tip a teal crystal, lashed to a short wrapped hilt with a tether clip at the end.

flare_gun.brief: Fat flare pistol, the cartridge in its breech is a tiny finned rocket. Accent: coral red.
flare_gun.description: Lying across the box: a fat-barrelled flare pistol with its breech hinged open; the cartridge inside is a tiny coral red rocket with fins and a pointed nose.

boomerang_blade.brief: V-shaped blade cut from a ship's wing tip, steering thrusters on both ends. Accent: copper.
boomerang_blade.description: Lying across the box: a V-shaped blade cut from a spaceship's wing tip, a tiny steering thruster on each end so it curves back in zero gravity, a wrapped grip in the bend. Copper edges.

plasma_sword.brief: Plasma blade on a docking-clamp hilt with vent-fin guard. Accent: coral red.
plasma_sword.description: Upright through the tall box: a hilt made from a docking clamp, a crossguard of vent fins, a small coolant bottle screwed into the pommel, above it a long flat coral red blade of plasma with a black core line.

harpoon_launcher.brief: Wreck-catching harpoon launcher with a magnet grab and towline. Accent: copper.
harpoon_launcher.description: Lying along the long box: a shoulder launcher made from a cargo crane arm, a barbed harpoon head with a round magnet grab in front, a coiled towline hanging under the barrel. Built for catching drifting wrecks.

cryo_sprayer.brief: Spray gun with a tank of Rime methane ice, hexagon frost spray. Accent: teal.
cryo_sprayer.description: Lying across the box: a spray gun with a round tank of frozen methane from the night planet Rime on top, frost crust on the nozzle, a few flat teal hexagon ice crystals stuck to the nozzle.

ion_blaster.brief: Blaster whose barrel is three floating rings like planet rings. Accent: teal.
ion_blaster.description: Upright, muzzle up: a blaster whose barrel is three teal rings floating apart with nothing between them, like stacked planet rings, below a bulky grip with a small battery dial.

spore_launcher.brief: Living tube gun grown from a Murk puffball, spore pods inside. Accent: sage.
spore_launcher.description: Lying across the box: a tube gun grown from a giant puffball fungus of the fog planet Murk, its breech a hinged mushroom cap, round sage spore pods inside.

meteor_hammer.brief: Hammer whose head is a whole little meteor with a re-entry scorch. Accent: coral red.
meteor_hammer.description: Filling the square box diagonally: a short iron haft with a lumpy dark meteor fused on as the head, its front scorched from re-entry with flat coral red crack shapes, no glow. Leather wrap on the grip.

tentacle_whip.brief: Whip of a nebula squid tentacle, tip curled like a galaxy. Accent: cream.
tentacle_whip.description: Along the long box: a wrapped hilt at one end, from it a long tapering tentacle of a squid from the Veil nebula in loose curves, a row of cream suckers, its tip curled into a spiral like a small galaxy.

shock_gauntlet.brief: Space-suit glove with plated knuckles and a coil battery. Accent: mustard.
shock_gauntlet.description: Upright: one armoured space-suit glove clenched into a fist, heavy plated knuckles, a small coil battery on the wrist, two flat mustard sparks jumping between the knuckles.

needle_rifle.brief: Long thin rifle with a drum of crystal needles from Facet. Accent: teal.
needle_rifle.description: Along the long box: a thin long-barrelled rifle with a slim stock and a long scope, under the middle a see-through drum full of teal crystal needles from the planet Facet.

acid_flask.brief: Flask with a pressure valve, acid floating as a ball inside. Accent: sage.
acid_flask.description: A round flask with a pressure valve instead of a stopper, sage acid inside floating as a ball in zero gravity, one drop eating a hole in the glass.

ripper_saw.brief: Hand saw whose tooth chain circles the bar like a planet ring. Accent: coral red.
ripper_saw.description: Lying across the box: a short hand saw whose chain of black triangle teeth circles a flat bar like a planet's ring, a chunky coral red motor grip at the back with a tether clip.

railgun.brief: Two rails from a station docking track on a boxy grip. Accent: teal.
railgun.description: Along the long box: two straight parallel teal rails taken from a station's docking track, braces between them, a boxy grip and a fat capacitor at the back end.

gamma_lance.brief: Pole lance tipped with a caged reactor rod. Accent: mustard.
gamma_lance.description: Along the long box: a long pole lance, its tip a heavy reactor rod in a small cage marked with three flat mustard radiation wedges, a cable spiralling down the shaft to a battery at the butt.

swarm_missiles.brief: Honeycomb rack of small rockets with a tether clip. Accent: coral red.
swarm_missiles.description: A square honeycomb rack seen from the front, every cell holding a small coral red rocket nose, two cells empty and scorched, a short tether clip on the top edge. The whole rack fits inside the frame.

antimatter_dagger.brief: Dagger with a blade of black void, debris falling into it. Accent: cream.
antimatter_dagger.description: A small dagger whose blade is a flat black void with a crisp cream outline, two tiny specks of debris falling into it, an iron hilt with a containment ring.

photon_bow.brief: Bow bent from a solar panel strip, arrow with a star head. Accent: mustard.
photon_bow.description: Upright through the tall box: a bow bent from a long strip of solar panel with flat teal cells, the string a straight mustard line, a small five-pointed star at the top tip.

void_scythe.brief: L-shaped scythe whose blade is a slice of night sky. Accent: cream.
void_scythe.description: The curved blade sweeps across the top row, the long shaft runs down the left cells; the right lower cells stay empty. The blade is a slice of night sky, black with a few tiny cream stars and a thin crescent moon; the shaft plain iron with a tether ring.

solar_cannon.brief: Heavy cannon with a sun-shaped fan of heat plates round the muzzle. Accent: mustard.
solar_cannon.description: A heavy, squat cannon lying across the box, muzzle to one side. Around the muzzle a fan of bent metal plates like a sun-shaped heat shield; scorched plating on the barrel and two fat cables running back into a boxy breech. Mustard only on the plates of the fan.

graviton_maul.brief: Maul with a round head circled by two orbit rings carrying debris. Accent: teal.
graviton_maul.description: The heavy head fills the upper four cells, the haft drops down the lower left cell; the lower right stays empty. Around the round head two thin teal orbit rings tilt at an angle; small debris pieces hang in the rings.

ram_plate.brief: Dented hull plate with a riveted ram spike, scavenged from a wreck. Accent: teal.
ram_plate.description: Lying across the box: a dented hull plate with a short riveted ram spike in the middle, a faint teal ring of force around the spike.

drone_bay.brief: Open scrap hatch with three tiny welded drones peeking out. Accent: copper.
drone_bay.description: Lying across the box: an open hatch built from scrap, three tiny welded drones with copper rotors peeking out, one already lifting off.

marrow_treat.brief: Thick cracked bone with marrow, tied with a fur cord. Accent: cream.
marrow_treat.description: A thick cracked bone with soft marrow inside, tied with a fur cord, a few crumbs around it.

trellis.brief: Small lattice of bent lab rods, thin tendrils climbing it. Accent: sage.
trellis.description: A small lattice of bent lab rods stuck in a pot, thin sage tendrils climbing up it and reaching sideways.

frost_bell.brief: Small dark bell rimmed with frost, a cold ring hanging below. Accent: teal.
frost_bell.description: A small dark iron bell rimmed with frost, a ring of teal cold drawn as ink lines below it.

breach_ram.brief: Short hydraulic ram with a blunt riveted head on a welded arm. Accent: teal.
breach_ram.description: Standing upright: a short hydraulic ram on a welded arm, blunt riveted head scuffed bare, teal force lines drawn as ink arcs where its shield field gathers.

siege_ram.brief: Long piston ram with a heavy wedge head and shield plates along its flanks. Accent: teal.
siege_ram.description: Lying lengthwise: a long piston ram with a heavy wedge head, salvaged shield plates bolted along both flanks, hoses taped to the piston, teal force lines at the tip.

glutton_toad.brief: Fat grinning toad with three stalk eyes and a cratered belly. Accent: sage.
glutton_toad.description: A fat round sage toad sitting upright, wide grin, three eyes on short stalks, crater-like spots on its round belly, cheeks bulging with food, a few crumbs on its chin.

trough_boar.brief: Stocky bristled boar with small tusks, snout deep in a scrap of food. Accent: mustard.
trough_boar.description: Lying across the box: a stocky boar seen from the side, bristled mustard back, small tusks, snout down in a half-eaten root, crumbs flying.

dawn_needle.brief: Thin iron throwing needle with a sun-ray tip and a copper grip. Accent: copper.
dawn_needle.description: Standing upright: a thin dark iron throwing needle, its tip forged as a small mustard sun ray, the grip wound in copper wire with a coral red band.

zenith_lance.brief: Slim iron lance with a sun disc below its point, a sun ray shooting off the tip. Accent: mustard.
zenith_lance.description: Standing tall: a slim dark iron lance of the order, a small mustard sun disc below a long point, a coral red band and prayer cords on the shaft.

pebble_mites.brief: One tiny mite whose shell is a round ore pebble. Accent: mustard.
pebble_mites.description: One single tiny mite whose shell is a round grey pebble with a mustard ore speck, six thin legs and two long feelers, room around it.

needle_wasps.brief: One needle wasp with a syringe stinger and solar-sail wings. Accent: mustard.
needle_wasps.description: One single needle wasp in side view: lean striped body, a long hollow stinger like a syringe needle, stiff ribbed wings like small solar sails, a cluster of small eyes.

thorn_hedge.brief: Dense low hedge of thorny branches grown out of a cracked lab planter. Accent: sage.
thorn_hedge.description: Lying across the box: a dense low hedge of thorny branches growing out of a cracked lab planter, black hooked thorns, a torn strip of suit fabric caught in them.

rot_bloom.brief: Wilted dark flower in a specimen jar, thick sap dripping from its petals. Accent: coral red.
rot_bloom.description: Lying across the box: a wilted dark flower slumped out of a cracked specimen jar, drooping petals with no eyes or face, thick coral red sap dripping from the tips into a small puddle.

dune_ox.brief: Shaggy ox with dish-shaped horns and a mossy saddle back. Accent: copper.
dune_ox.description: Filling the square box: one big shaggy ox of the Herdworld plains in side view, all four legs clearly visible, head lowered, its two horns shaped like small satellite dishes, its broad back a flat saddle of moss. One front hoof scraping the ground.

tundra_yak.brief: Ice-spiked yak with snowshoe hooves and big pale eyes. Accent: teal.
tundra_yak.description: Filling the square box: a huge yak from a frozen night planet. Its shaggy coat is stiff with blue ice spikes, its hooves are wide and flat like snowshoes for walking on frozen methane seas, and big pale eyes for the long darkness. Short heavy horns, a dented copper bell on a rope.
